title: Cookie Policy
description: Cookie policy for {{COMPANY_NAME}}: how cookies and browser storage are used on this site.
body:
The {{COMPANY_NAME}} website ({{SITE_URL}}) uses minimal browser storage and optional cookies to deliver a smooth browsing experience.

## 1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when visiting a website. They help preserve core site behavior and, where enabled, measure site performance.

## 2. Categories of Cookies

a) Essential: Required for core navigation, form interactions, and security.
b) Analytics (Optional): Loaded only if analytics tracking is configured and you explicitly consent.

## 3. Managing Cookies

You can clear or block cookies anytime using your browser settings. Disabling optional cookies will not prevent you from browsing our portfolio or sending a project inquiry.
